Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting civil or criminal liabilities or penalties for actions related to the Washington state health insurance pool.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting civil or criminal liabilities orpenalties for actions related to the Washington state health insurancepool; and amending RCW 48.41.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.41.190 and 1989 c 121 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Neither the participation by members, the establishment of rates,forms, or procedures for coverages issued by the pool, nor any otherjoint or collective action required by this chapter or the state ofWashington shall be the basis of any legal action, civil or criminalliability or penalty against the pool, any member of the board ofdirectors, or members of the pool either jointly or separately.)) Thepool, members of the pool, board directors of the pool, officers of thepool, employees of the pool, the commissioner, the commissioner'srepresentatives, and the commissioner's employees shall not be civillyor criminally liable and shall not have any penalty or cause of actionof any nature arise against them for any action taken or not taken,including any discretionary decision or failure to make a discretionarydecision, when the action or inaction is done in good faith and in the p. 1 SSB 5473performance of the powers and duties under this chapter: PROVIDED,HOWEVER, That nothing in this section shall prohibit legal actionsagainst the pool to enforce the pool's statutory or contractual dutiesor obligations.
